decision.explanation: The documents present two distinct individuals as the head of government of County of Bentheim. Document d1 describes Marius-Gabriel Gheorghiță as the current figure in authority, while document d2 refers to Friedrich Kethorn as the head of government in 1920. Since these accounts refer to different time periods and do not resolve which is more relevant to the question, both names are included as independently justified claims.
